### Daily Disciples Devotional: Watch Your Stubbornness
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-dec-10-2008-11596768.html
Passage: Hosea 4:16
Points:
- Compares a stubborn pet avoiding a bath to human resistance toward spiritual cleansing.
- Israel acted like a stubborn calf by quickly forgetting God's care and returning to sinful habits.
- Christians often resist the uncomfortable process of sanctification and conviction.
- Remaining stubborn allows believers to grow dangerously comfortable with unconfessed sin.
- Yielding promptly to God's washing brings immediate peace and spiritual refreshment.
